name: Phantom stroke (vagina)
description: Tease their folds with an unseen psychic hand, from anywhere in sight.
message: %USER% stares intently at %TARGET%, who squirms as if touched by unseen hands.
%USER% flexes %USER_PRONOUN_THEIR% fingers at a distance, and %TARGET% shudders.
%USER% narrows %USER_PRONOUN_THEIR% eyes at %TARGET%, whose thighs press together at nothing at all.
user_messages: You trace phantom fingers along %TARGET%'s folds from afar.
You press an unseen palm against %TARGET%'s mound, rubbing slow circles from a distance.
target_messages: Invisible fingers trace along your folds!
An unseen palm presses against your mound, rubbing slow circles!
